facts.text: All undergraduates complete the Dialogues core curriculum, taking one course each year across Self and Society, Belief and Reason, and Justice and Civic Life.

sources.title: Dialogues We have a unique core curriculum | Lynn University
sources.quote: The Dialogues are comprised of three core sections: Self and Society, Belief and Reason, and Justice and Civic Life. As a student, you'll take one course in each core section every year.
